subject.title: fix(feishu): disable ambient proxy inheritance for WebSocket by default

question: Should Feishu WebSocket egress switch from ambient-proxy-by-default to direct-by-default with `OPENCLAW_FEISHU_WS_USE_PROXY=1` as the proxy opt-in?
rationale: The patch changes upgrade behavior and a security-sensitive egress boundary for existing deployments, which automation cannot decide from code correctness alone.

options.title: Finish Direct-Default Contract
options.body: Accept the direct-by-default policy only after adding docs, fixing test cleanup, providing current-head real transport proof, and recording maintainer approval.

options.title: Preserve Proxy-Default Upgrades
options.body: Keep ambient proxy inheritance as the default and add an explicit Feishu direct/bypass mode if existing proxy-required deployments should remain unchanged.

options.title: Pause For Broader Proxy Policy
options.body: Hold this PR until the Feishu HTTP and mixed-proxy policy work defines one consistent channel-level routing model.

recommendation.title: Finish Direct-Default Contract
recommendation.body: Accept the direct-by-default policy only after adding docs, fixing test cleanup, providing current-head real transport proof, and recording maintainer approval.

likelyOwner.reason: This person is tied to the shared proxy helper history and was explicitly asked by the contributor to confirm the egress-policy default.
